observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability projection, exact checkout authority validation, and targeted regressions

outcome.implementation_change: The environmental-capability projection now preserves bounded sanitized authority.denied records and same-session repetition candidates with exact event references. Absolute Git targets resolve through observed checkout identity and mutation checks require matching registered checkout scope.
outcome.analysis_limit: Tests verify the authority contract and projection behavior. No post-change agent merge operation has been observed, and the intended scope and appropriateness of either historical denial remain unknown.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

improvement_relation.basis: The projection exposes two sanitized merge-denial records with canonical event references and derives a same-session pressure candidate. The authority boundary maps absolute targets through observed checkout identity and checks the exact worktree claim. Focused tests cover exact-claim authorization, unknown-target denial, and mismatched-scope denial. This change is verified; historical target appropriateness and post-change operational effect remain unestablished.
